_about: Daily check-in, one question per screen. Content from 'Periodic Health Tasks Checklist' section 6 (symptom diary, every evening, about 5 minutes) and section 11 (sleep diary, every morning), plus the mental check-in of 'Mental Health notes'. Levels live in thresholds.json -> symptomDiary.
redFlags: Weakness in an arm or leg

sleep.bedtime: When did you go to bed?
sleep.wakeups: How many times did you wake up?

complaint.severity: How strong is it? 0 none · 10 worst

actions.yellow: Write the severity twice a day and report it in the weekly private medical conference. If it gets worse, report it at once.
actions.red: Call the crew medical officer now. If there is a link, start a medical conference with the flight surgeon today. Thoughts of self-harm need an emergency conference at once: do not stay alone.

reminders._about: Gamification (Space Apps challenge: 'a gamification system to help astronauts engage with tasks that support their health'; team idea 15 Nov 2026): a reminder to the astronaut when a check-in part is still open at this hour (UTC), and a 'don't break the chain' streak. Not medical; display settings.
